answer: Farming becomes a garden bet on surviving 83 epochs of grading, and every signal settlement recomputes the sonnet schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 83 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 6 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
